speaker: Doctor
text:
I need to ask a few more questions to narrow down the cause of your fatigue, night sweats, and weight loss. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or stool appearance? 

Also, do you have a history of liver disease or alcohol use?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those are significant symptoms, but I need to determine if this is related to the lymph node you mentioned earlier. Have you experienced any fevers or chills, and have you noticed any changes in your appetite or ability to eat?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: CBC with differential, LDH, and ESR.

Are you experiencing any difficulty swallowing or breathing with the enlarged node?

REQUEST IMAGES: Neck ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the elevated WBC, slightly decreased hemoglobin, and high LDH along with a painless, fixed supraclavicular lymph node and significant weight loss, we must urgently rule out lymphoma. Did you notice any new lumps elsewhere on your body, such as in your armpits or groin? Also, have you had any persistent cough or shortness of breath recently?

REQUEST TEST: CT Chest/Abdomen/Pelvis.
